figurative_meaning_en: Preservation of existence or control over life and death
similar_in_english: A matter of life and death
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সিদ্ধান্ত তার বাঁচন-মরণের মতো গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
example_sentences_in_english: Our life and death are all in God's hands.
This decision is as crucial as a matter of life and death for him.
note: The idiom often implies ultimate dependence on a higher power, common in Bengali expressions of faith.
